parts.name: Vessel & foot ring
parts.description: Rounded vessel, neck, foot ring and drainage notches. Generic training construction; actual equipment varies.

parts.name: Instruction label
parts.description: The native decal describes the simulated training unit. Real agent compatibility and instructions must come from the actual unit label.

parts.name: Safety pin & retaining ring
parts.description: Metal pin, ring, seal loop and flag. Removed-state inspection retains the pin on the tray.

parts.name: Tamper seal & flag
parts.description: A loop and paper flag illustrate a tamper-evident attachment. No invented approval or serial number is presented.

parts.name: Inspection tag & tie
parts.description: A separate folded card, eyelet, cord and knot. The illustration is not evidence that a real unit has been inspected.

parts.name: Valve-neck thread
parts.description: A helical machined ridge shows how a threaded fitting differs from a smooth collar. Inspection only; do not dismantle equipment.

parts.name: Lever, pivot & washer
parts.description: Separate lever, pivot fastener, washer and screw slot; the procedure shows ordered operating states.

parts.name: Gauge face & needle
parts.description: Ticks, a coloured sector and an authored needle position. This is not a live pressure measurement.

parts.name: Hose, grip & coupling
parts.description: Curved hose, ribbed grip and coupling. The damaged specimen exposes a split and illustrative reinforcement strands.

parts.name: Split hose reinforcement
parts.description: Visible reinforcement strands in the damaged specimen. The damage is illustrative, not a manufacturer-specific hose cross-section.

parts.name: Display & controls
parts.description: Illustrative SIM display and controls; never a live gas reading.

parts.name: Sensor grille & inlet
parts.description: Separate grille openings, inlet collar and fitting ridges.

parts.name: Service slip & belt clip
parts.description: Back-mounted slip, hinge and clip. Rotate to the back to inspect.

parts.name: Lanyard & grip
parts.description: Curved carrying loop and grip ribs. The illustration does not establish suitability for an atmosphere.

parts.name: Guard & fasteners
parts.description: Separate guard mesh, frame and screw heads; compare the missing-guard specimen.

parts.name: Lock & keyway
parts.description: Distinct lock body, shackle and keyway. Model inspection does not establish safe isolation.

parts.name: Lockout tag & tie
parts.description: Attached warning tag, eyelet, tie and folded slip. Follow the authorised site isolation procedure.

parts.name: Cable & strain relief
parts.description: Routing, protective sleeve and ridges on the cable gland.

parts.name: Emergency-stop control
parts.description: A separate control; stopping alone is not verified energy isolation.

parts.name: Helmet shell & brim
parts.description: Crown, ribs and brim; compare the authored cracked specimen.

parts.name: Suspension webbing & stitches
parts.description: Under-brim suspension straps, individual stitch runs and adjustable buckles. Woven detail is illustrative, not a material-strength simulation.

parts.name: Care slip
parts.description: Under-brim care slip with folded corner. Actual care and replacement instructions vary.

parts.name: Lenses, frame & hinges
parts.description: Separate lens surfaces, frame, bridge and hinges; inspect the damage specimen.

parts.name: Ear cushions & seams
parts.description: Cushion seams and adjustment hardware; protection and fit require appropriate real equipment.

parts.name: Communication & reporting
parts.description: Illustrative communication equipment and reporting supplies.

parts.name: Supply card & folded slip
parts.description: Folded instruction card and fine printed rows. Use approved local emergency procedures.

parts.name: Assembly and route cues
parts.description: Miniature orientation cues; not navigation through a real building.
